question: Which of the following Trophies/Cups is related to football?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Santosh Trophy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Santosh Trophy is a prestigious national football tournament in India.
 
• It is an annual competition contested by state teams and government institutions under the All India Football Federation (AIFF).
 
• The trophy is named after the late Maharaja Sir Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhary of Santosh.
 
• It has been held since 1941 and is one of the oldest football tournaments in India.
 
• The tournament aims to promote football at the grassroots level across various states and regions in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Davis Cup**

 
 
• The Davis Cup is an international team event in men's tennis organized by the International Tennis Federation (ITF).
 
• It is the world's largest annual international team competition in sport, with over 140 nations participating.
 
 
 
• **Sultan Azlan Shah Cup**
 
 
• The Sultan Azlan Shah Cup is an annual international men's field hockey tournament held in Malaysia.
 
• It is named after Sultan Azlan Shah, the ninth Yang di-Pertuan Agong of Malaysia.
 
 
 
• **Ranji Trophy**
 
 
• The Ranji Trophy is a domestic first-class cricket championship played in India between multiple teams representing regional and state cricket associations.
 
• The competition is named after the famous cricketer Ranjitsinhji.
